## dub-localize-lab-example

US-safe multi-speaker clone-and-translate (YouTube / podcast localization). Occupancy **audio** — stop Klein / Wan / LTX first.

1. **I have rights** must be on. Queue refuses otherwise. Clone only recordings you own or have speaker consent to translate.
2. **Source file**: pick wav/mp4/mkv already in `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/input` (container `/inputs`), or **Upload media**. Optional **Source URL** for http(s) (`yt-dlp`). Host helper: `./scripts/utilities/dub-fetch.sh run --url URL` then reload the App so the file appears in the dropdown.
3. Stage **all** (default): faster-whisper segments become turns, speakers cluster with Chatterbox `ve.pt`, per-speaker clone refs write under `dubs/<slug>/speakers/` (6–12 s), then per-turn GGUF translate + cached Chatterbox V3 clone. After Queue, **Dub status** lists speaker/turn counts and `translated N/M`. Missing llama.cpp / GGUF with Rewrite translation **on** is blocking (empty mix, empty `text_target`) — Queue does not clone English as the target. Stage **analyze** writes JSON to edit; then Queue with Rewrite translation **off** and Stage **render**.
4. Chatterbox Multilingual V3 (MIT, PerTh on) — ISO `language_id` (`es`, not `Spanish`). Needs the complete snapshot (`ve.pt`, `s3gen.pt`, T3 V3, tokenizer JSON, `conds.pt`), not t3-only `comfy/tts`, and a wheel whose `from_local` accepts `t3_model=v3` (GitHub pin, not PyPI 0.1.7). Qwen3-TTS is the Apache alt (`download-podcast --tier qwen3tts`). Missing ASR/clone/llama.cpp: empty mix + **Dub status** (never the original recording). Clone lines longer than 300 characters are split.
5. Saves: `ez_dub_mix` FLAC + `ez_dub_yt` 320 kbps MP3 (duration-locked). Job dir also has WAV, SRT, speaker refs, and disclosure.txt.
6. YouTube Studio: Languages → Add language → upload `ez_dub_yt` (audio-only, same length). Flip the synthetic/altered-content toggle. MLA eligibility varies by channel.
7. Loudness: `./scripts/utilities/podcast-loudnorm.sh run --in FILE --target youtube` (−14 LUFS).
8. No lip-sync. No celebrity refs. Spoken bumper (optional) overlays the first ~3 s.

Disclosure sidecar: This audio is an AI-translated dub. Voices are synthesized from the original speakers with the rights-holder's authorization.

Weights: `./scripts/manage.sh download-dub --tier asr` then `--tier clone` (pip-installs faster-whisper, the llama-cpp-python CPU wheel, then the Chatterbox V3 GitHub zip --no-deps --force-reinstall so torch 2.14 stays). Queue self-heals a missing llama.cpp wheel (needed for `text_target`). Missing pack is not a doctor failure. On DGX Spark, faster-whisper uses the CPU CTranslate2 wheel.

Occupancy: audio — stop Klein / Wan / LTX session. One GB10 job.

extra.lab_description: US-safe multi-speaker dub: rights-gated ingest, diarize, translate, Chatterbox ML V3 clone, duration-locked YouTube track

inputs.description: Audio or video already in COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR/input (container /inputs). Default (none).
inputs.label: Source file

inputs.description: Upload wav/mp3/mp4/mkv into input/. Requires I have rights on Queue.
inputs.label: Upload media

inputs.description: Optional http(s) URL you have rights to fetch. Overrides Source file when set.
inputs.label: Source URL

inputs.description: Required. Off refuses Queue. No celebrity refs.
inputs.label: I have rights

inputs.description: Editable turns JSON. Rewrite translation fills text_target.
inputs.label: Translation

inputs.description: On: diarize + ASR + GGUF translate. Off: pin this JSON.
inputs.label: Rewrite translation

inputs.description: Language to speak. Spanish is the soccer-podcast default.
inputs.label: Target language

inputs.description: auto detects from ASR. Pin when the show is mixed-language.
inputs.label: Source language

inputs.description: 0 = auto (cap 8). Hint when you know the cast size.
inputs.label: Max speakers

inputs.description: all = analyze+render. analyze writes JSON. render clones the widget.
inputs.label: Stage

inputs.description: chatterbox-ml (MIT, 23 langs, PerTh on) or qwen3tts (Apache).
inputs.label: Clone engine

inputs.description: On: keep original ambience in gaps. Off: speech-only mix.
inputs.label: Keep original bed

inputs.description: On: overlay a 3 s spoken bumper. Sidecar is always written.
inputs.label: Spoken disclosure

inputs.description: TTS speed. 1.0 is the Kokoro default.
inputs.label: Speaking speed
